project_info.theme: Shopee x Laneige radiant summer beach beauty poster
project_info.color_palette: Bright sky blue, sandy beige, pastel pink, sunny yellow, aqua pool blue

main_subject.detail: Cute summer beauty ad centered on an oversized pink Laneige cushion compact opened to reveal the puff, placed on top of a yellow-and-white inflatable swim ring on a beach.
main_subject.style: Glossy 3D product illustration mixed with photoreal beach props, playful summer ecommerce aesthetic

composition_elements.text: LANEIGE / CĂNG MONG RẠNG RỠ DA XINH TỎA SÁNG
items: Top Left: White Shopee bag logo, divider line, and lavender Laneige wordmark badge.
Top Right: Tropical palm leaves and bright blue sky with soft vignette.
Bottom Left: Yellow-and-white inflatable ring, tiny rubber duck float, and pool edge transitioning into beach sand.
Bottom Right: Small beach ball, orange starfish, beach loungers, umbrellas, and ocean horizon.
Center/Background: Large pink Laneige cushion compact with embossed lid and branded puff, lit like a premium 3D hero object on a sunny beach.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm beach highlights, soft toy-like gloss on the compact, cheerful vacation atmosphere, clean product shadows

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Shopee x Laneige radiant summer beach beauty poster. Centerpiece is an oversized pink Laneige cushion compact opened to show the branded puff, sitting inside a yellow-and-white inflatable ring on beach sand. Background is a bright tropical beach with blue sky, pool water, palm trees, loungers, umbrellas, and playful summer props. Surrounding elements: Shopee and Laneige logos at top left, exact headline 'CĂNG MONG RẠNG RỠ DA XINH TỎA SÁNG', a beach ball, starfish, duck float, and resort details. Technical style: photorealistic 3D advertising illustration, bright summer sunlight, warm beach highlights and clean product shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
